key: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
s: On mount Hor Aaron’s garments pass to Eleazar and Aaron dies there; Rashi, on Numbers 20:29, reads the mourners as men and women alike, for Aaron pursued peace and brought love between quarrellers and between husband and wife.
src: Rashi, Commentary on the Torah, on Numbers 20:29, Hebrew of the Rosenbaum and Silbermann edition (1929 to 1934), Sefaria export 3f10136 (2026)

evidence.words: כל בית ישראל. הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים, לְפִי שֶׁהָיָה אַהֲרֹן רוֹדֵף שָׁלוֹם וּמַטִּיל אַהֲבָה בֵּין בַּעֲלֵי מְרִיבָה וּבֵין אִישׁ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ
evidence.gloss: [Rashi on 20:29, ‘all the house of Israel’:] The men and the women, because Aaron pursued peace and put love between parties to a quarrel and between a man and his wife.

reason: Key verse verbatim (verse.js ok, ref Numbers 20:29 and at [136,29] match). Plain sense faithful to 20:25 to 28: on mount Hor Moses strips Aaron of his garments, puts them on Eleazar, and Aaron dies on the top of the mount. Rashi on 20:29, on ‘all the house of Israel’, says: the men and the women, because Aaron pursued peace and put love between quarrellers and between man and wife (citing Avot deRabbi Natan 12): the sentence paraphrases this without drift. entry-check ok.
